target.statement: Augmenting the original training data with Code2Math-evolved problems improves Qwen3-8B Avg@10 accuracy on AIME24 from 42.3% (original) to 48.0% (+5.7)
target.table_ref: Table 2, row AIME24, column Qwen3-8B Orig.+Evol.

compute.basis: Requires evolving 2,500 problems via closed-source LLM APIs (GLM-5.3-Flash), generating CoT solutions with Qwen3-30B, and SFT training Qwen3-8B for 6 epochs on a GPU; the 8-core/16GB CPU laptop cannot run the training or the API-based evolution pipeline.

blockers: Requires closed-source LLM APIs (GLM-5.3-Flash, GPT-5.2-High) for evolution and judging
Requires GPU for SFT training of Qwen3-8B
Training corpus of 2,500 problems and evolved versions not confirmed as publicly downloadable
Full pipeline involves multiple stages (evolution, verification, CoT generation, SFT) not feasible on a CPU-only laptop
title: Code2Math: Can Your Code Agent Evolve Math Problems Through Exploration?
